title: ci(dogfood): the three Dogfood Regression Gate shards run on merge_group
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_

Part of #30461 (the card stays open: the follow-up ruling 6669982756 owes a 24-hour reading of the queue builds after this lands, then the required-set step)
Ruling-ref: 6663883327
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：合并队列（`merge_group`）现在也跑三个 `Dogfood Regression Gate` 分片；PR 上照旧不跑，`Dogfood Verify CLI`、Temporal Conformance、UI Published Artifacts 仍只在 `main` 的全量里跑。顺带把说明文字和两个读 `if:` 的仓内工具改到与新行为一致。
- **为什么改**：按裁决 B 执行。10-22 以来有 9 张 dogfood 引起的 `main` 红，都是合进去之后才发现；现在 dogfood 红会出现在该条目的队列构建上，比等 `main` 推送后才发现更早（目前只是提示，不拦合并）。
- **风险与回滚**：每个队列条目多 3 个 runner 作业（push 上实测每片约 11 分钟，与 Test Core 并行，Test Core 在队列里中位约 21 分钟才收尾）。注意：`Dogfood Regression Gate` 自 #22998 起不在必需检查里，所以队列里 dogfood 红**不会**自动把条目踢出，只是让红提前可见；是否加回必需集合已由后续裁定 6669982756（A，分两步）定下：本 PR 先落地，不动规则集；落地后 24 小时读队列构建的 dogfood 红与抖动，读数干净再由你把它加进规则集（车道先合一行 `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`）。回滚只需 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的 `dogfood` 作业 `if:`（只删了 `merge_group` 一项）；② 同文件 THE TWO SPEEDS 注释块；③ `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `jobIfReading`。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --roster | grep Dogfood`，应看到分片一行只排除 `pull_request`，`Dogfood Verify CLI` 一行仍排除 `pull_request|merge_group`。
- **需要你做的**：审批本 PR（`.github/workflows/**` 与 `AGENTS.md` 属 Tier H），席位随后落地。

## What changes

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the `dogfood` job: its `if:` drops `&& github.event_name != 'merge_group'` and nothing else. `!cancelled()`, the `core` filter term and the `pull_request` exclusion stay. `dogfood-verify`, `temporal-conformance` and `ui-published-artifacts` keep both exclusions (the ruling's second line). No affected-only filter: on `merge_group` the `core` output is `'true'` by its existing guard, so the shards run on every queue entry (letter C is not ruled).
- What the job `needs:` on the queue: `filter` only. It runs on every event, and its `core` output is `'true'` on `merge_group`, so the shards cannot skip silently there. No other needed job is denied on `merge_group`, so nothing else is widened.
- Prose brought in line with the new split: THE TWO SPEEDS block, the `core` output's reader list, the `dogfood` job and `dogfood-gate` comments (ci.yml); `release.yml`'s `full-battery` comment; `upgrade-harness-optin.yml`'s gap paragraph; `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` HALF 3; the `check-required-contexts.mjs` tombstone; `AGENTS.md`'s Two speeds line and its detail in `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md`.
- Two repo gates read job `if:` spellings, and the new one (`pull_request` excluded alone) changed what they said:
  - `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs`: the shards stay in the derived roster (a PR head still skips them), but their reason no longer says "full battery only". A `pr-event` term that excludes only `pull_request` now reads "skips on every PR head and is answered by the merge-queue build and main's push and scheduled runs". The fixture tree models the live shape, with three new self-test cases.
  - `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`: `jobIfReading` refused a lone `!= 'pull_request'` clause, so the dogfood shards' path population (the dogfood leads `--commands` exists to give) would have dropped. It now strips that clause the same way as the full-battery one (exact spelling, last conjunct only) and returns `notOnPullRequest` beside `fullBatteryOnly`. The row clause says "does NOT run on this PR … its first run on this change is the merge-queue build". `merge_group` excluded alone is still refused. Self-test: the near-miss case is re-pointed, and new cases cover the clause, its position, the doubled spelling, both flags, and a LIVE pin on the shards' row with an in-place ablation. The full-battery LIVE pin stays on `Dogfood Verify CLI`, as the test's own note asks.
- Read and left alone, from the code: `check-shard-attestation.mjs` reads no event in any `if:`. Its verdict already judges a full dogfood matrix beside a skipped CLI leg green (self-test case "each leg is judged on its own roster"), so a queue build counts 3 credentials plus 0 expected. `check-required-contexts.mjs` pins only registry rows, and `Dogfood Regression Gate` is not one (prose only, above). `check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` reads filter globs, not events.

## Queue wall time (before)

Window: the 24 hours before the read, runs created at or after `2026-11-04T18:41:25Z` (read 2026-11-05T18:41Z, at `origin/main` `6701c08a44`).

```
gh api -X GET "repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?event=merge_group&created=%3E%3D2026-11-04T18:41:25Z&per_page=100&page=N"   # N = 1..4
duration = updated_at - run_started_at, completed runs, run_attempt 1 throughout
```

| `ci.yml` on `merge_group`, last 24 h | n | median | p90 | max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| completed, every conclusion | 303 | 20.5 min | 26.0 min | 32.8 min |
| `success` | 285 | 20.4 min | 25.8 min | 32.8 min |
| `failure` | 18 | 21.9 min | 26.7 min | 27.8 min |

(306 runs listed, 3 still `in_progress`, none cancelled.)

What finishes last in a queue run, from the jobs of the 60 newest `success` runs (`repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/RUN_ID/jobs?per_page=100&filter=latest`, offset = job `completed_at` minus the run's first job `created_at`): `Test Core` closes 38 of 60 runs at a median of 20.8 min (p90 25.9), then `Test UI` (11) and `Lint UI` (10). `Build Core` closes at a median of 8.6 min.

Dogfood shards for comparison, from `main`'s push runs in the same window (`repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?event=push&branch=main&created=%3E%3D2026-11-04T18:41:25Z`, 135 runs; jobs read for 128 of the 130 completed ones, 2 reads answered 502). `success` jobs only, `completed_at - started_at`:

| job (push, `main`) | n | median | p90 | max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Dogfood Regression Gate (n/3)` shard | 282 | 11.4 min | 12.3 min | 14.2 min |
| `Dogfood Verify CLI` (stays off the queue) | 99 | 5.5 min | 8.3 min | 8.6 min |
| `Test Core (n/N)` shard, for scale | 790 | 12.6 min | 18.4 min | 26.0 min |

A shard (~11.4 min of execution, started after `filter`) fits inside the queue run's ~20.8 min `Test Core` close. So queue wall time should move little unless runner pickup slows under the +3 jobs per entry. That is the reading the seat's 24 h "after" measurement checks. It is not assumed here. The card's "~5 min per shard" figure is today's ~11.4 min on push.

## Tests

All readings at head `4bb48774cf` (this branch with `origin/main` `63de248a1c` merged once), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm build` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives **80** commands for this diff (10 paths). Each was run, and its exit code was recorded before any pipe. **All 80 exit 0.** `--ran` reconciles: "80 derived, 80 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" ("a DERIVED zero — all 80 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3").
- On the pre-merge head `57fd195a35`, four dist-reading gates first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no build): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`. After the build all four exit 0. `check:pm-skill-ratchet` went red on an `AGENTS.md` line of 123 bytes against the 120-byte budget. Commit `c029b25517` rewrapped it (no line added, ceiling 1050 held), and the gate exits 0. The final-head run above includes both.
- Edited tools' own suites, run beyond the derived list:
  - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` (both tiers): "2240 cases pass" (fast 1951 + slow 289).
  - `pnpm check:pm-expected-skips`: 209 cases pass, with the new reason and fixture cases.
  - `pnpm check:required-contexts`, `pnpm check:shard-attestation` and `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test` are in the 80 above.
- Full dogfood battery: not owed. There is no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm. The diff changes no test or runtime code, so no ablation either: a workflow, scripts and docs are out of its scope.
- CI check-runs on this PR: read at hand-off; the seat cites them.

## Acceptance notes

- ⚠ **The ruling's "ejects the PR from the queue" holds only when the context is required.** `Dogfood Regression Gate` has been outside the ruleset's required set since #22998, and AGENTS.md §7 lists the ten contexts the queue enforces. After this PR a dogfood red shows on the queue build and reds that run, but GitHub's merge queue holds an entry only on required checks, so the entry still merges and `main`'s push run goes red as before. Whether the context rejoins the required set (a ruleset change, plus a `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` row in `check:required-contexts`) was not ruled when this PR opened. The follow-up ruling 6669982756 (maintainer 「同意」, A in two steps) settles it: this PR lands without a ruleset change; after a clean 24-hour reading of the queue builds, a `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` row lands first and the maintainer adds the context to the ruleset after it.
- `AGENTS.md` and `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md` were outside the claim's file surface. They are edited because their Two speeds line restates the split this PR changes ("PR and queue runs carry the fast set"). The seat's delta corrected the detail file's stale "10 minutes of wall per queue entry" to the measured median.
- Carrier: none.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --roster` at this head: `Dogfood Regression Gate (${{ matrix.shard }}/3) … gate: job-gate filter core + pr-event pull_request` and `Dogfood Verify CLI … pr-event pull_request|merge_group`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at this head renders the shards' row as "⛔ does NOT run on this PR: its `if:` excludes the pull_request event, so its first run on this change is the merge-queue build, after the PR is enqueued", and `Dogfood Verify CLI`'s with the unchanged full-battery sentence.
- The live proof is this PR's own queue entry, and every entry after it: three `Dogfood Regression Gate (n/3)` jobs on a `merge_group` run, and `Dogfood Regression Gate` counting 3 credentials beside a skipped `Dogfood Verify CLI`.
